description:
Changes figures in the deal saved in the caller's TDE account, then answers whether the
order can be placed. Each change is kept as a new version of the deal, the old values are
returned under `changed` so they can be put back, and nothing is overwritten. Every figure is checked; one the plan needs and the deal
lacks is refused by name, never filled in. Needs the caller to connect their TDE account and
to allow changes.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.

changes.description: Figures to change, as {figure path: new value}, for example {"business.cash_on_hand_gbp": 90000, "navigator.shipping_time_months": 3}. Numbers are in the units TDE shows (GBP, percent, units, months); yes/no figures take true or false.
